documentation.content: One of the four provider switches (text model, text fallback, picture model, picture fallback) was switched from the owner console (`provider_profile_changed`, with `slot`, `from`, `to`, `uidHash`; the name is from the profiles the switches replaced). If you did not switch it, switch it back on the console or with `npm run admin -- providers set <slot> <from> --apply`, remove the account from `config/owner`, and read `providerProfileChanges/` in the Firestore console (each record names its switch). See functions/README.md, "Provider switches" and "The owner console". Switches made with the admin command are logged to the `admin` log and not alerted on.
